title: Happy kitten
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a2a4d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#f5a742'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#ffe2b0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 76 q14 -2 12 -16 q-1 -6 -7 -4 q4 8 -6 12 z' fill='#e8902e'/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffe2b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffe2b0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#f9b453'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M32 27 l-4 -16 l15 8 z' fill='#f9b453'/>
  <path d='M68 27 l4 -16 l-15 8 z' fill='#f9b453'/>
  <path d='M34 26 l-2 -9 l9 5 z' fill='#ff9fb2'/>
  <path d='M66 26 l2 -9 l-9 5 z' fill='#ff9fb2'/>
  <!-- stripes on head -->
  <path d='M44 21 q2 6 0 10' stroke='#e8902e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 21 q-2 6 0 10' stroke='#e8902e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2f8f6b'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2f8f6b'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#c8ffe6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#c8ffe6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 46 h6 l-3 4 z' fill='#ff7d9c'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M44 50 q6 6 12 0' stroke='#7a4a1e' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M28 42 h10' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 48 h10' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 42 h-10' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 48 h-10' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#ff9fb2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#ff9fb2' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
